outcome: Epidemiologic and demographic characteristics of immigrant women admitted to gynecology or obstetrics departments
cohort: 605 immigrant women hospitalized in a maternity hospital in south-west Slovenia between 2012 and 2017
finding: Immigrant women had a higher rate of cesarean section compared to Slovenian women, and education level was a significant predictor of abortion in immigrant women.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher among immigrant women compared to Slovenian women.
